attempts.text:
**The window starts in a six-column spine.** Columns 0 to 5, `qmcA`, `ybbJ`, `cueR`, `ybaT`, `glsA` and `copA`, are persistent, carried by 94 to 100% of chromosomes, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 19% of calls. The model names 89 to 99.8% of them, fewest at `ybaT` with 89%, and hesitates most at `cueR`, 0.44 bits.

**Column 6 is variable**, in a region of plasticity in 19% of calls, the stretch most in regions of plasticity. The model names 94% of calls there, at 0.23 bits. Then columns 7 to 24 form a spine carried by 93 to 95% of chromosomes, in a region of plasticity in 2 to 21% of calls; the model names 78 to 99%, fewest at `ybaK` with 78%, and hesitates most at `fsr`, 0.59 bits, the window's most hesitant column.

**A single variable column, 25, sits at 3%**, named in 96% of calls. The long spine of columns 26 to 68, carried by 91 to 95% of chromosomes, holds the efflux and oxidase genes, [[multidrug efflux and ubiquinol oxidase]], and the `rib` genes, [[riboflavin synthesis]]. The model names 94 to 99% there, fewest at `yajR` with 94%, hesitating most at `pdeB`, 0.48 bits.

**The window ends in fork and variable columns**, 69 to 79, in a region of plasticity in 1 to 2% of calls, the least of the window. The model names 97 to 99%, and no column hesitates more than 0.16 bits. The variable columns 69 to 77 carry `yajO` to `tsx`, from 90% down to 59%; column 78 is the fork, `yajD` in 53% and `espY3` in 11%; column 79, `secF`, is in 48%.

**Across the window the model names 97% of genes** at 0.20 bits. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 1.54 against 0.13 bits, and names fewer genes, 69% against 98%.

label: qmcA
facts:
WINDOW: the qmcA window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor qmcA, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 3,221 to 3,300 from dnaA. Read in 537 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying qmcA once); 42,960 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 97% of genes, 0.20 bits on average (perplexity 1.2 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 39,712 calls, named 99%, 0.12 bits; shell 2,942 calls, named 71%, 0.92 bits; cloud 306 calls, named 28%, 4.36 bits. Outside an RGP 40,783 calls, named 98%, 0.13 bits; inside an RGP 2,177 calls, named 69%, 1.54 bits. Columns: 67 spine, 1 fork, 12 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.54 against 0.13 bits) and names fewer genes (69% against 98%); 2,177 of the 42,960 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 10 (fsr) 0.59 bits, RGP 17%; column 9 (ushA) 0.56 bits, RGP 20%; column 32 (pdeB) 0.48 bits, RGP 2%. No column has most of its calls in an RGP.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: column 6 (variable), RGP 19%; the least: columns 69-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 1-2%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. columns 0-5 (6 columns) spine: share 94-100%, all P, RGP 0-19%. Genes: qmcA, ybbJ "NfeD family protein", cueR, ybaT "APC family permease", glsA, copA. named 89-99.8% (mean 96%), fewest named at column 3 (ybaT), named 89%; most hesitant at column 2 (cueR), 0.44 bits.
2. column 6 variable: RGP 19%. named 94%; 0.23 bits.
   6: ybaQ S 80% "HigA family addiction module antito…"
3. columns 7-24 (18 columns) spine: share 93-95%, all P, RGP 2-21%. Genes: ybaP "TraB/GumN family protein", ybaK "Cys-tRNA(Pro)/Cys-tRNA(Cys) deacyla…", ushA, fsr, ybaL "cation:proton antiporter", gsk, aes, hemH, adk, htpG, recR, ybaB "YbaB/EbfC family nucleoid-associate…", dnaX, apt, ybaN "DUF454 family protein", priC, rsmS, mscK. named 78-99% (mean 95%), fewest named at column 8 (ybaK), named 78%; most hesitant at column 10 (fsr), 0.59 bits.
4. column 25 variable: RGP 3%. named 96%; 0.37 bits.
   25: acrR P 90%
5. columns 26-68 (43 columns) spine: share 91-95%, all P, RGP 1-7%. Genes: acrA "multidrug efflux RND transporter pe…", acrB, tomB, hha, maa, ylaC "YlaC family protein", pdeB, ybaA "DUF1428 domain-containing protein", ybaZ "MGMT family protein", ybaY "YbaY family lipoprotein", tesB, amtB, glnK, mdlB "ATP-binding cassette domain-contain…", mdlA, decR, cof, ybaE "SgrR family transcriptional regulat…", queC, fadM, ybaV "helix-hairpin-helix domain-containi…", ppiD, hupB, lon, clpX, clpP "ATP-dependent Clp protease proteoly…", tig, bolA, yajG "lipoprotein", ampG, cyoA, cyoB, cyoC, cyoD "cytochrome o ubiquinol oxidase subu…", cyoE, yajR, yajQ "nucleotide binding protein YajQ", panE, yajL "DJ-1/PfpI family protein", thiI, xseB, ispA, dxs. named 94-99% (mean 97%), fewest named at column 61 (yajR), named 94%; most hesitant at column 32 (pdeB), 0.48 bits.
6. columns 69-79 (11 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 1-2%. named 97-99% (mean 98%), fewest named at column 69, named 97%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.16 bits (column 69).
   columns 69-77 variable, share 59-90%, all P: yajO "aldo/keto reductase" 90%, pgpA 87%, thiL 82%, nusB 78%, ribH 74%, ribD "bifunctional diaminohydroxyphosphor…" 71%, nrdR 69%, yajI "DUF3251 domain-containing protein" 65%, tsx 59%
   78 fork: yajD P 53% "HNH nuclease YajD"; also espY3 S 11%
   79 variable: secF P 48%
PRODUCTS of named genes (for [[ ]]): acrB efflux RND transporter permease AcrB; mdlA ATP-binding cassette domain-containing…; cyoA COX aromatic rich motif-containing prot…; cyoC cytochrome o ubiquinol oxidase subunit…; cyoE UbiA family prenyltransferase; ribH 6,7-dimethyl-8-ribityllumazine synthase; lapB ABC transporter transmembrane domain-co…; siiEA Ig-like domain-containing protein; espY3 pentapeptide repeat-containing protein
END: the window ends at column 79, secF, in 48% of chromosomes.
